title: WALLEDEVAL: A Comprehensive Safety Evaluation Toolkit for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating exaggerated safety and over-refusal behavior by prompting models with culturally specific safe and unsafe prompt pairs tailored to Singaporean (SGXSTEST) and Hindi (HIXSTEST) cultural contexts to identify a lack of culturally nuanced knowledge.

Assessing disparities in safety guardrails and harmful behavior recognition across eight different languages (Arabic, English, Filipino, French, Hindi, Russian, Serbian, Spanish) using the multilingual Aya Red-Teaming dataset.
